shortDescription: This module handles some common Riak operations

options.name: command
options.description: The command you would like to perform against the cluster.

options.name: config_dir
options.description: The path to the riak configuration directory.

options.name: http_conn
options.description: The IP address and port that is listening for Riak HTTP queries.

options.name: target_node
options.description: The target node for certain operations (join, ping).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wait_for_handoffs
options.description: Number of seconds to wait for handoffs to complete.

options.name: wait_for_ring
options.description: Number of seconds to wait for all nodes to agree on the ring.

options.name: wait_for_service
options.description: Waits for a riak service to come online before continuing.
